hero.headline: The Art of Stillness, Refined.
hero.sub: A quiet emerald retreat in Kammanahalli, where every ritual draws from tradition and finishes with care.

about.heading: A Different Kind of Quiet
about.body1: Orange International Spa's Bengaluru home carries the same devotion to craft as our original sanctuary, reimagined for a city that rarely slows down.
about.body2: Here, Ayurvedic ritual meets contemporary therapy inside interiors built for unhurried mornings and long evenings alike. Every treatment is performed with intention — because rest, done properly, is its own art.

services.heading: Rituals & Treatments
services.sub: Thirty experiences across ten collections — from classic massage to royal VVIP rituals. Call or message us on WhatsApp for any treatment.

gallery.heading: Inside the Sanctuary
gallery.body: Our Bengaluru interiors are still being finished. Photographs of the space will be added here soon — until then, come experience it in person.

footer.sister: A sister sanctuary to Orange International Spa, Morbi
